impact: A record deal would reshape the mega-cap and AI trade; no direct effect on Clement's holdings beyond index weight shifts.
summary: SpaceX and Tesla merger talks are advancing to a negotiation over price and control, with a possible announcement as soon as December or slipping into early 2027, Bloomberg reported. One main hurdle is ring-fencing Tesla's China business, and Texas's incoming attorney general vowed scrutiny. SpaceX is valued at about $1.90 trillion and Tesla about $1.55 trillion.
title: SpaceX-Tesla merger talks progress; deal possible in December
